_comment: Mutation testing (CLAUDE.md, Testing Conventions, gate 3). PRs pass --mutate with the changed line ranges (scripts/mutation/stryker_mutate_args.py); the nightly mutates everything below. The pass/fail floors live in scripts/mutation/floors.toml, read by scripts/mutation/gate.py, so thresholds.break stays null here. ignorePatterns are gitignore-style: each is anchored with a leading / so 'reports' cannot also drop src/features/reports. Stryker runs vitest.stryker.config.ts, which leaves out the suites that pin a timezone (they cannot under Stryker's threads pool).
